sharedRules.name: FOREST DWELLERS (1)
sharedRules.description: Until the end of the current Round, all models in this warband have the Pathfinder rule.

sharedRules.name: AMBUSH (1)
sharedRules.description:
During any Turn, if an enemy model ends its movement/action within 6” of ( or inside ) the nominated terrain then the Lurker is revealed and put in contact and Engaging the enemy model, in any arc.The Lurker doesn't count as Charging but may make an immediate free Melee attack. Resolve the attack and then mark the Lurker as Fatigued.  It may be activated later in the Round. If it survives, the enemy model's turn is then ended.

Alternatively, the Lurker may be revealed (costing no Power) at any time during one of its Warband turns. It is activated as normal and placed in, or within 1" of, the nominated terrain, at least 3" from any enemy model and starts its Turn marked as Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: Lurker
sharedRules.description: During deployment, choose any one of your SUPPORT models to become a Lurker ad nominate any piece of terrain ( not Impassable and not in a deployment zone ) for them to hide in. Make a note of the terrain piece and set the Lurker model to the side.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Barrier of Vines
sharedRules.description: Place a 1”x 6” marker anywhere within 12” of the caster, into Open Ground and clear of any models. The area described by the marker is Height 10 Impassable Terrain that blocks LOS. In the End Phase of each Round roll a die. On a 5+, the barrier is removed. The casting model can only have one such barrier in play at any time.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Vengeful Flock
sharedRules.description:
A blizzard of furious birds is summoned. Target a single enemy model within 6”. Roll 1D8 to see what happens: 
1-4 : the target and all models within 2" of it suffer a 2D8 6+ Melee attack (roll for each model separately)
5-6 : the target and all models within 2" of it suffer a 2D8 5+ Melee attack (roll for each model separately)
7-8 : the target model takes the full fury of the flock and suffers a 3D8 3+ Melee attack. In addition, if the model survives it is picked up and moved 6” in a direction of the casting player’s choice, and is then placed Knocked-down and Fatigued. The model cannot be placed in Impassable Terrain or within 1” of another model.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Trident
sharedRules.description: For any hit scored with this weapon the target model is automatically Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Net
sharedRules.description: Break away actions from this model are made rolling 2 dice for the armour roll rather than the normal 1. Each failed roll causes a wound as normal.

sharedRules.name: Attack - Elemental Fire
sharedRules.description: This model may make a Ranged attack with a Shoot action using Elemental Fire. Range 9”, 3D8, Breath. The attack always hits on a 5+ regardless of any modifiers.

sharedRules.name: NATURE'S INFERNO (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model makes a Ranged Attack with Elemental Fire before any dice are rolled. The attack has Piercing (1).

sharedRules.name: HIS MASTER'S VOICE (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability to activate up to two friendly Wild Companion models within 3" of a friendly COMMAND or SPELLCASTER Class model.  The activations are taken at the same time but the models may complete their activation independently (this is not a Group Action). This can be performed in addition to the normal +1 model activation if bought with Power.

sharedRules.name: RANGE BOOST (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability to increase the range of one of the caster’s spells by 6” (where a Range is specified). The RANGE BOOST must be paid for during the caster’s activation just before the chosen spell is cast.

sharedRules.name: NATURE'S DEFENCE (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when an enemy model attempts to cast a spell and is within 9” of this model. Before the spell is cast but after any boosting is declared, roll a die. On a 4+, the spell fails with no effect. Any action (short or long) or Power the model used is still spent.

sharedRules.name: ENTANGLE (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when the model suffers a Melee attack. The model has the Parry special rule until the attack is resolved.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Centaur Bow
sharedRules.description: Any hits scored when making a Ranged attack with this weapon have a Piercing value of (x), where x is the number of dice that FAILED to score a hit in the attack roll. For example, if a Ranged attack with the bow using 2D8 results in one hit and one miss, the single hit is resolved using Piercing(1).

sharedRules.name: Point to Prove
sharedRules.description: While within 6" of a friendly Centaur Chief model, this model automatically gets a Down But Not Out result when reduced to zero (or fewer) wounds, even though it is a GRUNT.

sharedRules.name: ORDEAL OF FIRE (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability during the model’s activation, before or after an action, even if it is Engaged or Knocked-down. Friendly Salamanders (including the Veteran itself) and Fire Elementals are immune to the effects of this attack. All other models within 2" take 2 automatic hits with Piercing (1). Make Armour rolls as normal. This ability can be used once per game.
